 Method of Preparation 
 Make the fine powder of ingredients from Gokshura Beeja (Tribulus terrestris) to Commiphora mukul. As per traditional Ayurveda methods, mercury and sulhpur are mixed to make kajjali (mercury powder ground with pure sulphur for purification). Now all the other ingredients are added in kharal (traditional device for grinding) and tablets of 375 mg are made using water. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Shukramatrika Bati is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the tablet form. It is used to manage the various complications like diabetes, urinary calculi, dysuria, fever, nightfall etc. Anti-diabetic action of this medicine is quite effective to manage the elevated blood sugar levels in body. In the problem of urinary calculi and dysuria, diuretic action of this medicine helps to extrude the solid particles through urine. This medicine also boosts up the immune system and also maintains the strength in body. It also acts well to manage the high body temperature in fever. On the other hand, shukramatrika bati is an effective medicine to resolve the various male problems like nightfall, loss of semen etc. It helps to prevent the sperm loss, improve the sperm quality and enhances the sperm production.

Shukramatrika Bati 
 Reference: Ayurved sar sangrah 
 Shukramatrika Bati is an herbal tablet which is used in treatment of diabetes and other genito-urinary tract diseases. This herbal medicine is very good in improving the sperm count and prevents the loss of sperm. Besides, it helps to cure the sexual debility and enhances the vigor in males. It balances vata and Kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 20 grams of each of:- 
 
 Gokshura Beeja – Tribulus terrestris 
 Triphala churna – (Haritaki – Terminalia chebula, Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica and Amalaki – Emblica officinalis) 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Ela – Cardamom – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Rasanjana – Aqueous extract of Berberis aristata 
 Dhanyaka – Coriander – Coriandrum sativum 
 Chavika – Piper chaba 
 Jeera – Cuminum cyminum 
 Taleesa – Abies webbiana 
 Tankana – Purified and processed Borax 
 Dadima – Pomegranate – Punica granatum 
 
 10 grams of Guggulu – Commiphora mukul 
 40 grams of each of:- 
 
 Purified and processed mercury 
 Abhraka – Purified and processed Silica Bhasma 
 Gandhaka – Purified and processed Sulphur Bhasma 
 Loha bhasma – Purified and Processed iron Bhasma 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Make the fine powder of ingredients from Gokshura Beeja (Tribulus terrestris) to Commiphora mukul. As per traditional Ayurveda methods, mercury and sulhpur are mixed to make kajjali (mercury powder ground with pure sulphur for purification). Now all the other ingredients are added in kharal (traditional device for grinding) and tablets of 375 mg are made using water. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Shukramatrika Bati is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the tablet form. It is used to manage the various complications like diabetes, urinary calculi, dysuria, fever, nightfall etc. Anti-diabetic action of this medicine is quite effective to manage the elevated blood sugar levels in body. In the problem of urinary calculi and dysuria, diuretic action of this medicine helps to extrude the solid particles through urine. This medicine also boosts up the immune system and also maintains the strength in body. It also acts well to manage the high body temperature in fever. On the other hand, shukramatrika bati is an effective medicine to resolve the various male problems like nightfall, loss of semen etc. It helps to prevent the sperm loss, improve the sperm quality and enhances the sperm production. 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes 
 Genito-urinary diseases like urinary calculi, dysurea. 
 Fever 
 Improves strength and immunity 
 Nightfall 
 Loss of semen with urine 
 Improves the sperm quality 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 1 – 2 tablets at before or after food, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is traditionally administered along with Pomegranate juice, or goat milk. 
 Side Effects 
 
 This medicine should only be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
